description: List recent entries from the server's write journal (write-journal.ndjson): every journaled write with its journalId, timestamp, tool, router, parameters (as redacted at write time), snapshot ids and outcome — newest first. Read-only. Use it to recover a lost journalId for rollback_change, or to audit what was written when. Only entries with rollbackable: true can be rolled back — dry runs and writes without snapshots (run_command, plan_changes) cannot.

routerId.description: Only entries for this router id

tool.description: Only entries written by this tool

name: list_journal
title: List Write Journal
